text:
incident-bot: PAGER: KV read latency spike (5x) and elevated errors in us-west-2 cluster. Candidates: hot prefix + memory pressure. P1. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-hotprefix. Paging oncall-anna.
oncall-anna: Saw it, acked. I'm booting up the diagnostic query and grabbing recent prefetech metrics.
sre-jordan: I'm joining — will check overlay logs and any recent autoscaler activity. Any deploys in the last 30m?
eng-runtime-marta: No code deploys in that window. We're seeing a concentrated hotkey pattern: prefix "acme-inc:session-*" is ~60% of reads and causing kv-store stallback & eviction churn.
customer-success-lee: CS: We've received a report from ACME that their inferences are timing out and throwing 429/503 intermittently. Working on a support ticket now.
oncall-anna: Mitigation plan (live): 1) apply temporary per-tenant deprioritization (weight=0.2) for acme-inc; 2) cap concurrent requests from that tenant to 50 rps; 3) set prefix to correctness-bypass mode so reads go direct to storage to avoid corrupt cache hits. Executing step 1 now.
incident-bot: action: tenant-weight-update applied for tenant=acme-inc by oncall-anna (weight=0.2).
eng-runtime-marta: Executing prefix bypass for correctness to avoid stale cache paths. Command: ```rctl prefix update --prefix "acme-inc:session-" --bypass-correctness=true --actor oncall-anna --note "live mitigation: prevent corrupted KV cache reads"```
infra-ops-ken: Also reducing prefix TTLs and evicting top hot keys to free memory. Running: ```python scripts/hotkey_eviction.py --prefix "acme-inc:session-" --evict 2000``` will lower memory and reduce KV tail latencies.
sre-jordan: Added traffic shaping rule on the edge: cap acme-inc -> 50rps and deprioritize to best-effort. If error-rate for platform drops <1% in 15m we'll keep flow and iterate.
incident-bot: telemetry note: cache-hit-rate (acme-inc) fell 98% -> 12% after bypass; platform-wide tail latency improved ~60th percentile by ~40%.
oncall-anna: CS-lee please confirm customer comms and note SLAs impacted. Tagging @customer-success-lee.
customer-success-lee: Reached out to ACME, explained temporary throttling for stability, offered priority ticket. Their engineering liaise confirmed partial recovery; they measured failed requests ~25% -> ~8% after the changes. ETA for full recovery unknown.
eng-runtime-marta: Observability note: KV errors for other tenants dropped quickly. We're seeing reduced eviction churn and memory pressure. Leaving bypass in place while we stabilize and collect a 30m window of data.
sre-jordan: Recommendation: keep bypass + deprioritization for up to 2 hours, then gradually restore TTL and remove bypass once hotkey heat reduces. Plan a gradual ramp to avoid re-triggering eviction storm.
oncall-anna: Handoff: I'm handing this to eng-runtime-marta for monitoring for the next 2h. I'll update incident doc and mark page as acknowledged -> mitigations applied. Postmortem scheduled; tagging follow-ups: follow:hotkey-detection, infra:ttl-tuning.
eng-runtime-marta: Taking over monitoring. I'll run a controlled TTL ramp: 60s -> 120s -> 300s with 20m observation windows. Will post metric snippets and logs here.
customer-success-lee: ACME confirms user-facing errors reduced; they want a timeline for full restore. I've scheduled a 1:1 with their SRE for status updates.
oncall-anna: Closing active pager for now — mitigations in place and eng-runtime-marta owning. Next steps: postmortem, hotkey mitigation automation, consider per-tenant circuit-breaker for heavy prefixes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
